messages:
Olivia: Heads-up: starting tenant-metadata migration in the 02:00 UTC change window. canary will run on 3 shards, deploybot scheduled for 02:05. tagging SRE and release leads.
DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: migration/mig-4272 at 02:05 UTC. Steps: apply DDL -> start backfill -> validate rows -> promote. Runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/mig-4272 
Aj: noted. rollback criteria proposal: avg backfill latency > 150ms OR error rate > 2% sustained for 5m -> abort and rollback. ok?
Maya: add replica-lag > 30s to abort criteria. also prefer pinning the migration version to avoid nonblocking fallbacks (use migration-v1.1).
Sam: if canary backfill looks slow i'd like a manual hold before promoting. propose holdpoint after step 2 for 10m to triage.
SRE-bot: metric alert: canary backfill queue length +20% vs baseline (see dashboard). auto-escalation threshold approaching.
Olivia: ok, we'll enact the holdpoint. Aj please pin the flag and pause autoscale for the canary pool.
Aj: done. pinned flag applied and autoscale paused. config snippet: `featureflag.mig_4272.pin = true`
DeployBot: Canary run started at 02:05. DDL applied on 3/3 canaries. Backfill progress: 12% complete. Holdpoint configured at step 2.
Maya: seeing tail write latency ~180ms for canary PG writes (baseline 90ms). I'm going to trigger manual hold.
Olivia: holding now and notifying release manager. Quick rollback decision rubric we use: if hold > 20m OR error rate spikes above 3% -> rollback. Aj, confirm who will run rollback.
Aj: I'll coordinate rollback if needed. Rollback playbook located in ops repo. If triggered, run `./ops/rollback.sh mig-4272 --target=canary` and unpin the feature flag. Ping me @aj before running.
Sam: prepping rollback resources and snapshot: snap-2024-06-17-0200 is ready for restore if we need it.
DeployBot: Hold engaged at 02:17. Canary stopped at backfill 14%. Next steps paused.
Olivia: creating CHG incident channel now and updating release notes: "mig-4272 held due to backfill latency; investigation in progress. DO NOT promote."
Maya: investigating query plan and KV cache pressure; will paste slow-query sample in 5m.
SRE-bot: metric update: replica lag climbed to 42s at 02:19 UTC; paging oncall.
Sam: prepared rollback command snippet in runbook:
```
./ops/rollback.sh mig-4272 --target=canary --snapshot=snap-2024-06-17-0200
```
Aj: standing by. if traces/data point to locking/backfill hotspot we'll rollback. otherwise we'll collect 15m of traces and decide.
Olivia: decision posted: if latency does not reduce within 15m -> rollback. I'll update last_message_ts after action.
